item.title: Indiana University Bloomington: Open-Rank, Tenured/Tenure-Track Faculty Position in Aging and Technology
item.description: Indiana University Bloomington (IUB) invites applications for an open-rank, tenured/tenure-track faculty position in the School of Public Health-Bloomington in the field of Aging and Technology.

item.title: University of Virginia: Tenure-track Open Rank Position in Health Intervention & Implementation Science within the Department of Public Health Sciences
item.description: The University of Virginia (UVA) Department of Public Health Sciences (PHS) and the Community Cancer Control and Obesity Research Center (CORC) are seeking applicants for a tenure-eligible open rank faculty position within the division of Health Intervention & Implementation Science. The candidate will develop and lead a multidisciplinary research program focused on cancer prevention involving nutrition and/or obesity in rural and low-resourced communities in the UVA Cancer Center’s catchment area and beyond.

item.title: UCLA: Postdoctoral Fellow in Biopsychosocial Processes in Mental and Physical Health
item.description: The goal of the program is to train research scientists in the integration of biological, psychological, social, and cultural levels of analysis to study mental and physical health.

item.title: University of California San Francisco: Postdoctoral Fellowship in Dyadic Health and Artificial Intelligence
item.description: Are you interested in close relationships, behavioral health, and the rapidly evolving possibilities of AI for behavioral science? Join the Conroy Dyadic Health Lab at UCSF to help develop innovative, human-centered approaches that harness both interpersonal relationships and AI to improve health across cardiovascular disease, substance use, mental health, and HIV.

item.title: Utah State University: Assistant Professor - Clinical/Counseling Psychology
item.description: The Department of Psychology at Utah State University invites applications for a tenure-track, nine-month academic year Assistant Professor in Clinical or Counseling Health Psychology with a strong background in Clinical Neuroscience whose research examines the intersection of psychological processes, health, and neuroscience.

item.title: Columbia University, Mailman School of Public Health: Stephen Smith Professor and Chair of Sociomedical Sciences
item.description: The Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health invites nominations and applications for the role of Stephen Smith Professor and Chair of the Department of Sociomedical Sciences (SMS). Reporting directly to the Dean and serving as a member of the School's leadership team, the Chair will lead a department that is widely recognized for its contributions to understanding how social, cultural, economic, political, and environmental factors shape health and health equity and the development and evaluation of interventions that address these factors.

item.title: University of Alabama at Birmingham: Cancer Population Science Faculty
item.description: The University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) Heersink School of Medicine (HSOM) and the O’Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center at UAB are leading a recruitment effort to significantly expand the number and variety of investigators conducting research in cancer population science, including but not limited to cancer epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, health services research, behavioral and social science, implementation science, cancer prevention and control, policy, economics, and outcomes.

item.title: Dana Farber Cancer Instuitute: Chief, Division of Psychosocial Oncology
item.description: The Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI) Department of Supportive Oncology seeks a nationally recognized leader to be Chief of the Division of Psychosocial Oncology. This individual will oversee the Division’s faculty, clinical staff, and trainees, and provide academic leadership to the Division.

item.title: University of Rochester: T32 Fellowship / Research Assistant Professor
item.description: Now in its 23rd year, the NCI-funded T32 Clinical and Translational Cancer Control Research Training Program at the University of Rochester and NCI-Designated Wilmot Cancer Institute is seeking outstanding candidates for our upcoming group of post-doctoral fellows starting in summer, 2027.

item.title: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Psycho-Oncology
item.description: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, a preeminent comprehensive cancer center in New York, New York, is recruiting for postdoctoral trainees to join its Psycho-Oncology Research Training Program. We are seeking outstanding postdoctoral research fellowship candidates for mentored research training in the psychological and behavioral aspects of cancer.

item.title: Rush University: Chairperson, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
item.description: Rush University Medical Center, a nationally recognized clinical and academic institution and the teaching hospital for Rush Medical College of Rush University, invites nominations and applications for the position of Chairperson of the Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences. The successful candidate will provide strategic, innovative, and operational leadership, and will have responsibility and accountability for the clinical and academic performance of all divisions within the Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences.

item.title: University of Florida: Tenure-Track Professor, Clinical Health Psychology or Clinical Child/Pediatric Psychology
item.description: The Department of Clinical and Health Psychology at the University of Florida is excited to invite applications for 6 tenure-track Associate or Assistant Professors: 3 in Clinical Health Psychology and 3 in Clinical Child/Pediatric Psychology. These are full-time (1.0 FTE), 12-month tenure-track positions in our APA-accredited clinical psychology doctoral program.

item.title: Fit Minded: Associate Research Scientist
item.description: Join an applied science firm serving digital health companies. You’ll design and run studies, including RCTs, analyze data in R, write manuscripts, and support client projects.

item.title: University of Utah: Palliative Care Psychologist
item.description: The University of Utah Palliative Care Services Program invites applications for a psychologist position in our adult palliative care clinic located in Salt Lake City, Utah. The psychologist will provide psychological assessment and evidence-based interventions for patients with serious illness and their families within an outpatient palliative care setting.

item.title: Children's Hospital of Richmond at VCU: Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Pediatric Obesity
item.description: The Healthy Lifestyles Center, a comprehensive pediatric obesity treatment and research center, is hiring a postdoctoral research fellow to become an integral member of their research team in the area of pediatric obesity treatment, prevention, and policy. The qualified individual will be involved in several clinical research studies regarding pediatric obesity treatment, school-and community-based nutrition policy, and other related behavioral medicine investigations.

item.title: Virginia Commonwealth University: Postdoctoral Fellow, Department of Social and Behavioral Sciences
item.description: The Department of Social and Behavioral Sciences in the Virginia Commonwealth University School of Public Health seeks applicants for a postdoctoral research fellowship under the mentorship of Dr. Jessica LaRose. Applicants with an evidenced commitment to community-engaged research and behavioral interventions are strongly encouraged to apply.

item.title: University of Florida: Open Rank Tenure Track Faculty Position, Health Education and Behavior
item.description: The UF Department of Health Education and Behavior (HEB) seeks qualified applicants for an open rank, tenured or tenure track faculty position. This 9-month, full-time, tenure-accruing, on-campus appointment is scheduled to begin 8/16/27 and is supported by a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as a start-up package commensurate with rank and experience.

item.title: Virginia Commonwealth University: Open Rank Faculty, Social and Behavioral Sciences
item.description: The Department of Social and Behavioral Sciences in the Virginia Commonwealth University School of Public Health invites applications for a full-time 12-month, tenure-eligible, open rank faculty member. We particularly welcome applicants with formal training and methodological expertise in behavioral clinical trials, intervention science, and community-engaged research, especially in cancer disparities, rural health, chronic disease prevention and management, or related areas aligned with departmental strengths.
